question: Does the visible focus code contain statements that can never execute, such as code after an unconditional return/throw or a branch whose condition is visibly always false?

criteria.unreachable: At least one visible statement cannot execute.
criteria.insufficient: Reachability depends on code or values that are not visible.

independentTest.corpus: two public repositories never used to tune the questions
independentTest.sample: random cells at or above the 0.7 cut
independentTest.reviewer: LLM (Claude Opus 5.5), first pass from the code excerpts alone; no human labels
independentTest.note: No cell of this signal was at or above the 0.7 cut in either repository, so nothing was reviewed.

evidence.corpus: daily-tracker (sanitized development snapshot, one TypeScript/React Native app)
evidence.sample: top-5 cells by P at or above the 0.7 cut, plus 3 random cells below it
evidence.reviewer: LLM (Claude Opus 5.5), pass 2 with repository access; pass 1 counts in EVIDENCE.md
evidence.note: One cell above the cut in the whole run, and it was actionable: too few to gate on. Reviewed by one LLM reviewer (Claude Opus 5.5) in two passes; not human truth. Cells were the highest-P above the 0.7 cut, so the rate is an upper bound.
